verdict.rationale: vLLM runs an HTTP API server, so offering a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence only says the server is OpenAI-compatible (also Anthropic Messages and gRPC) and never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec being published or downloadable. API compatibility with another vendor is an adjacent feature, not a spec the product itself provides.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
